intervention.note: the only change against round20 is that the F1 band and its gap are drawn 45 frames before they become lethal

physics.note: constant hold/right/left replays through the unmodified advance; unchanged from the pre-registration and independent of the renderer

split.rule: one group = base + mirror, atomic; within each family the groups are ordered by group name (candidate index) and alternate train/validation starting with train at index 0; the two F2 groups therefore give one train and one validation group

storage.dtype: uint8 (the renderer output verbatim, never cast to float on disk)
storage.container: npz deflate for the pixel regions, torch.save (xb) for history/labels
storage.scale: uint8 -> float32 /255 happens only at load through vision.regions_to_batch
storage.hud: hud_score/hud_status are byte-identical across all 80 decisions (asserted per event); stored once as [1,3,H,W,C] and expanded to 80 rows at load, so the values are identical while the 80 redundant copies are not written
storage.why: a float32 copy of the same content is 4x larger and adds nothing: every consumer divides by 255 immediately

data.history_semantics: identical to round20: actual executed candidate (ACTION_MAP), previous_hold 2, frame_delta 2, option BOS3, target_valid false, history_valid from row 1
data.label_semantics: identical to round20: the one-hot of the single successful teacher route first action; action_valid = teacher_verified; nothing else

round20_reference.f1_deaths: round20: 41/41 F1 deaths happen exactly on wall_frame, i.e. never inside the gap (P1-f1-visibility-round20.md, reconstructed by the subtask from the stored actions)

pooled.note: six (arm, seed) pairs, six F1 validation events each; descriptive only

limitations: n=3 seeds and 7 validation groups; the 14 validation events collapse to 7 geometries because a mirror is not an independent sample
F2 validation is a single group (2 events) built on two nearly identical worlds, so an F2 validation number is not a rate
the only intervention is a renderer; physics, worlds, split, teacher, labels and training are round20
the teacher is handed the real world geometry; "distillation" means fitting that one route

the F1 win condition is exact parking inside a 12-20 px gap and the F3 win condition is a timed threshold crossing; neither is tactical understanding, and this round cannot show that a policy understands a telegraph, only whether the same task became learnable once the danger was visible
the 45-frame lead is a single design choice and is not ablated here
synthetic fixed-y worlds, two-frame actions, no shot, no bomb, no real TH08 pixels
research heads only: no formal gate, no deployable checkpoint, no game
